summary: Health Catalyst filed an 8-K reporting completion of the divestiture of VitalWare, LLC to Med-Metrix, LLC for a base purchase price of $147 million, subject to customary adjustments. Proceeds, with cash on hand, were used to repay in full its credit facility, including $122.8 million term loan and $37.1 million delayed draw, plus a $3.2 million prepayment premium, terminating the facility and releasing liens. The deal closed July 31, 2026, following a June 4, 2026 agreement. Watch for final purchase-price adjustments and any ongoing indemnification obligations; no premium or board advisor disclosed.
